name: Radio Sutatenza rural radio schools
description: An educational radio-school system combining broadcasts with community support for rural learners in Colombia.

date.basis: Date stated by the cited source; see event scope.

events.statement: José Joaquín Salcedo began a rural radio-school project from Sutatenza in Colombia.

evidence.supports: Nomination dates start of rural radio-school project to 1947 and identifies Salcedo.

events.caveats: This dates the project, not a documented nationwide audience or later cumulative reach.

events.statement: UNESCO reported that the educational project reached 687 Colombian localities and trained 20,039 rural leaders.

evidence.supports: UNESCO reports coverage of 687 localities and 20,039 trained rural leaders over the project.

events.caveats: Retrospective cumulative figures across the educational project; no single-year listener count or inferred contemporaneous reach.

earliest_record.rationale: Earliest dated episode established in cited evidence for this scope, not a global priority claim.
